request.purpose: Official statistics on the prevalence of chronic diseases for the national health report.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of adults with obesity, by sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per sex: adults with obesity who have a BMI and their mean BMI, one decimal.
